name: @wewin/api
//type: Deliberately absent, which makes this package CommonJS. Nest's DI reads `design:paramtypes`, which only `emitDecoratorMetadata` produces and only the TypeScript compiler emits — so this app cannot be ESM-by-type-stripping. It consumes ESM-only @wewin/core through Node's require(ESM); see tsconfig.json for the full reasoning.
//test: `test` compiles first because tests/esm-bridge.test.ts inspects and executes the emitted CommonJS — the require(ESM) arrangement cannot be proven from inside Vitest, which resolves everything as ESM.
//scripts: No @nestjs/cli. The CLI carries its own `typescript` dependency, so `nest build` would compile with a different compiler than `pnpm typecheck` — and this repo's rule is that what CI type-checks is what production runs (plan section 1). Plain `tsc`, one compiler, same as packages/core.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U wewin -d wewin
